title: September 1993 meeting with Wright-Patterson FASTC colonel

tellings.quote: the colonel in charge of the Wright Patterson Air Force Base operations for this uh Colonel Canola when he said to me

plain: Steven Greer, a man who campaigns for the government to reveal UFO secrets, says that in September 1993 he met a colonel he calls Colonel Canola at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. He describes Canola as in charge of the base's operations on this subject, under the FASTC, an Air Force center that studies foreign aircraft and technology, and he also mentions an Admiral Kramer. If true, it would mean a senior officer at a key Air Force base spoke with him directly about UFO matters.
